title: Snowflake and Orange Business: Sovereign AI for France
summary: Snowflake and Orange Business collaborate to deliver sovereign data and AI capabilities on trusted French infrastructure for regulated industries.
body_markdown:
Adopting cutting-edge AI across France's enterprise and public sectors should not have to come at the expense of regulatory control. Digital sovereignty today hinges as much on local operational authority as it does on physical data location – enabling daily management, incident response and governance controls to remain firmly within national and continental borders.


This operational dimension lies at the heart of France's evolving security standards, including ANSSI's SecNumCloud qualification. To meet these expectations, organizations need an ecosystem where advanced analytics and local operational control work seamlessly together.


Today, Snowflake is proud to announce its intent to collaborate with Orange Business as an operating partner in France. This initiative will pair Snowflake's AI Data Cloud with Orange Business's operational expertise to deliver a sovereign-by-design data and AI platform built on sovereign infrastructure – such as Bleu – tailored for the French market.


## Operational sovereignty, built for trust


True digital sovereignty requires protecting both data and operations: from hosting data within national borders and executing platform management through local entities, to supporting accountability under local law. Bringing these imperatives together is the ethos of a “Cloud de Confiance”, or trusted cloud environment where digital trust is built and measured across multiple dimensions, including resilience, security, privacy, regulatory compliance, data localization, operational integrity and technological autonomy.


Through this intended partnership, Orange Business will bring its extensive public sector experience and trusted end-to-end managed services to the Snowflake ecosystem.


“French institutions require world-class innovation backed by uncompromised local governance. Partnering with Snowflake on Bleu enables us to pair Orange Business’s operational capabilities and trusted integration services with leading-edge data and AI – giving our clients full control over their digital future.”


##### Aliette Mousnier-Lompré


Directrice Générale, Orange Business


Organizations leveraging this proposed collaboration between Snowflake and Orange Business will receive core structural benefits:


### European operational governance


Platform operations including administration, monitoring, support and incident response will be conducted by European teams subject to EU law. Customer contracts will be established directly with Orange Business.


### Data residency


Regulated data stays strictly within local boundaries. The environment will be engineered to support ANSSI’s SecNumCloud qualification pathway and align with


[SEAL operational frameworks](https://commission.europa.eu/news-and-media/news/sovereign-cloud-framework-explained-2026-06-01_en) .


### Open data standards


Snowflake leverages the open Apache Iceberg™ table format on S3-compatible storage. This supports data ownership and portability, allowing seamless access even if provider relationships change, which mitigates the impact of kill switch scenarios.


### Enterprise AI with safeguards


Snowflake Cortex AI provides access to a broad portfolio of self-hosted, open-source and frontier models, including EU models, through a single, unified API, all running within a trusted cloud perimeter. If a model becomes unavailable, is discontinued or raises regulatory concerns, customers will be able to seamlessly switch to an alternative without changing their application code or data pipelines. This model portability enables organizations to retain full control over their AI strategy without being locked into any single model provider.


“Our customers in France’s regulated sectors have been clear: they need a data platform that is not just hosted in France, but run by France. Orange Business brings the operational credibility, public sector trust and legal accountability our customers require. Together, we are shaping a sovereign model designed to cover architecture, operations and contracting.”


##### Dayne Turbitt


SVP EMEA, Snowflake


[Learn more about Snowflake’s data sovereignty capabilities](https://www.snowflake.com/en/company/overview/data-sovereignty-europe/) ****
